He has also served on Assurant&#8217;s Board of Directors since that time. Prior to his appointment as Chief Executive Officer, Mr. Demmings served as President of Assurant from 2021 to 2022, overseeing all operating segments, including Global Lifestyle and Global Housing. Earlier, he served as Executive Vice President and President, Global Lifestyle from 2016 to 2021, Executive Vice President and President, Global Markets from 2015 to 2016, and Executive Vice President and President, International, from 2013 to 2015, with responsibility for Assurant&#8217;s international operations across multiple regions.</font></div></td><td colspan="3" style="padding:0 1pt;vertical-align:top"><div style="text-align:center"><img alt="keithdemmingsa.jpg" src="keithdemmingsa.jpg" style="height:208px;margin-bottom:5pt;vertical-align:text-bottom;width:163px"></div></td></tr></table></div><div style="margin-bottom:8pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:134%">Since joining the predecessor to Assurant in 1997, Mr. Demmings has held leadership positions of increasing responsibility, including President, Canada. Throughout his nearly three decades with the organization, he has led businesses across North America, Asia, Europe, and Latin America, with responsibility for strategy, financial performance, and growth across international and domestic operations. He earned a Bachelor of Commerce degree from the University of Victoria. </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:8pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:134%">&#8220;We are pleased to welcome Keith to Moody&#8217;s Board of Directors,&#8221; said Vincent Forlenza, Chairman of Moody&#8217;s Corporation. &#8220;Keith&#8217;s proven leadership, global operating experience and deep insurance expertise will be a tremendous asset to the Board. As the insurance sector continues to play a critical role in helping businesses and communities manage risk, Keith&#8217;s perspective will complement Moody&#8217;s own focus on empowering customers with data, insights and solutions to navigate an increasingly complex world. We look forward to his contributions as Moody&#8217;s continues to drive innovation and long-term growth.&#8221;</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:8pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="margin-bottom:8pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:134%">ABOUT MOODY&#8217;S CORPORATION</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:8pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:134%">In a world shaped by increasingly interconnected risks, Moody&#8217;s (NYSE&#58;MCO) data, insights, and innovative technologies help customers develop a holistic view of their world and unlock opportunities. With a rich history of experience in global markets and a diverse workforce of approximately 16,000 across more than 40 countries, Moody&#8217;s gives customers the comprehensive perspective needed to act with confidence and thrive. </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:8pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:134%">For Moody&#8217;s Investor Relations</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:134%"><br>Shivani Kak<br>Moody&#8217;s Corporation<br>+1.212.553.0298<br>shivani.kak&#64;moodys.com </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:8pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:134%">For Moody&#8217;s Communications</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:134%"><br>Chris Cashman<br>Moody&#8217;s Corporation<br>+1.212.553.0729<br>chris.cashman&#64;moodys.com </font></div><div style="height:50.4pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div><font><br></font></div></div></div><script type="text/javascript"  src="/-JBR7li4DkT5p/OZVi4VcD8h/adzw/7fEtQmwkLrLcwGSO/NiohS1Jc/fhsqEBM-/PkA"></script></body></html>
